title: Synthesis of trifunctional indole-imine-based Ag NPs as a molecular probe for selective colorimetric detection of Cd(II), photo-catalytic and antimicrobial agent
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,9631-9647
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07704D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Muhammad Kashif, Abdul Rauf Raza, Shoaib Akhtar, Khaled Fahmy Fawy, Muhammad Sher, Umar Nishan, Muhammad Imran Irfan, Azhar Abbas
A novel indole-imine Schiff base enabled one-pot synthesis of multifunctional AgNPs, serving as a Cd2+ colorimetric nanoprobe (LOD 27.8 nM), solar photocatalyst (95%), and enhanced antibacterial agent via silver-ligand synergy.
